shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"lastUsage|afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata|receives collected response\" src specs package.json CHANGELOG* && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,90p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,90p' CHANGELOG.md && rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src scripts | head -80 && rg --files | rg 'reanchor|prettier|package-lock|yarn.lock' && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts | sed -n '1,70p' && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "Aggregate usage across provider rounds" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
